title: Spheres entering the water at Guadalupe Island

tellings.quote: uh Lou Alzando and I think Sean Cahill went down to Guadalupe Island because there have been reports of

plain: A UFO writer, Marik von Rennenkampf, says that Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who worked on UFO reports, and Sean Cahill, a former Navy sailor, went to Guadalupe Island off Mexico for a National Geographic television series called Unidentified. They went, he says, because there had been reports of glowing spheres going in and out of the water there. If true, it would suggest these objects move between sky and sea.
